title: Climatic regions in Eastern Africa
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use rainfall and temperature graphs for four towns (Kampala, Lodwar, Mombasa, Nyeri). The child reads the bars before naming the region.

skills.key_step: The child names the climatic regions of Eastern Africa and places each.

floor.question: Which region of Kenya is hot and dry?

representations: a climate map of Eastern Africa
steps: Say why it is there (height, sea, lake).
contexts: the Serengeti in the tropical region
the Danakil in the arid region

board.do: Draw the outline of Eastern Africa.
Point at the area around Lake Victoria.

misconceptions.ask: Which climate does northern Kenya have?
misconceptions.repair: Compare a rain table of Kisumu and Lodwar.

misconceptions.ask: Where is the highland climate found?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens to temperature as we climb.

misconceptions.ask: Does Kenya have one climatic region or several?
misconceptions.repair: Colour the climate map: Kenya has many colours.

misconceptions.ask: Where is the mountain climate found?
misconceptions.repair: Shade the mountains on the relief map and the mountain climate on the climate map.

checks.question: Which climatic region is found around Lake Victoria?
Name two climatic regions found in Kenya.
checks.answer: any two of: arid, semi-arid, tropical, highland, coastal

skills.key_step: The child describes temperature and rainfall in each region.

floor.prerequisite: Names and places the climatic regions.
floor.question: Where is the arid region?
floor.answer: northern Kenya, Somalia and the Horn

steps: Describe: hot or cool, wet or dry, one season or two.

board.do: Draw twelve tall bars and twelve short bars.

board.say: Which region has rain like this all year?

board.do: Write the traits under each graph.

misconceptions.ask: Which description fits the arid region?
misconceptions.repair: Use a two-line table: rain and heat for each region.

listen_for: It is nearer the sun so it is hot
misconceptions.ask: Why is the top of Mount Kenya cold although it is on the equator?
misconceptions.repair: Use the fact that temperature falls with height; ask about the snow on Kilimanjaro.

misconceptions.ask: How many main seasons does the tropical (savanna) region have?
misconceptions.repair: Compare a Kampala and a Dodoma rainfall graph.

misconceptions.ask: What are nights like in the arid region?
misconceptions.repair: Read day and night temperatures for Lodwar.

checks.question: Describe the climate of the equatorial region.
Why is the highland region cool?
checks.answer: it is high above the sea

skills.key_step: The child links climate to what people do: crops, herding, tourism.
representations: a climate map with crops drawn
steps: Ask what grows or lives there.

board.do: Draw a mountain with a tea bush on its slope.

misconceptions.ask: Why is tea grown in the cool, wet highlands?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens to tea in the dry north.

misconceptions.ask: What does a long drought cause?
misconceptions.repair: Draw rain cloud and no rain cloud and say what each does to farms.
Show Kericho on the climate map.

listen_for: They do not want to settle
misconceptions.ask: Why do herders in the arid north move with their animals?
misconceptions.repair: Show a dry-season map of water points.

checks.question: Which activity suits the arid region?
Why is coffee grown in the highlands?
checks.answer: the climate is cool and wet
